description: This file implements the SerialPort class and related functionality for serial communication, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, as well as a SerialMonitor class for monitoring serial ports on Windows.

classes.name: SerialMonitor
classes.description: A class for monitoring serial ports on Windows, managing port events and threading.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: A class for managing serial port communication, including configuration, opening, closing, reading, and writing.

methods.name: SerialPort::Convert
methods.description: Converts a numeric speed to a BaudRate enum value.

methods.name: SerialPort::Configuration
methods.description: Configures the serial port with specified parameters.

methods.name: SerialPort::Open
methods.description: Opens the serial port with the current configuration.

methods.name: SerialPort::Settings
methods.description: Applies the current configuration settings to the serial port.

methods.name: SerialPort::Trigger
methods.description: Triggers an event on the serial port.

methods.name: SerialPort::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the serial port.

methods.name: SerialPort::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the serial port.
